skills.delivery_notes: default dual-wield melee attack-replacer with a Weapon Pool Skill (WPS) suite proccing off each auto-attack ('Default dual-wield melee swings with WPS pool skills proccing off each auto-attack; 100%+ WPS chance means every swing fires a WPS proc'; 'Belgothian set fills the primary attack slot, modified by WPS abilities (currently at 117% WPS chance)'). Replacer maps NATIVE per §A row: at-target-melee, single-target-per-hit, attack-speed tempo. Each WPS hit is single-target ('Each WPS hit is single target'). WPS chance-procs = weapon-layer trigger riders (§A) -- see trigger_grammar. Pierce/physical: no element family; NO ailment named.

summoned blade companion providing additional AoE pressure ('Blade Spirit can provide additional AoE pressure'). Only 'additional AoE pressure' is fetched -- mapped as an orbiting-blade proxy (phrase-book orbiting blades -> orbit); autonomous-combatant depth NOT attested, so no pet-gap flag, treated as a supplemental AoE rider.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: §A default-attack-replacer + WPS row: Cadence-default replacer maps NATIVE (melee_strike, attack-speed tempo); WPS suite = weapon-layer trigger riders (sibling of devotion-proc row), modeled as on-hit-threshold burst-damage since every swing at 117% fires a proc. Each WPS proc's own payload needs its own fetched behavior (§0.4) -- none individually fetched, so no per-WPS skill rows. Pierce = physical-substrate, element-neutral (THE PHYSICAL RULE); ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL fits the pierce-conversion identity. Belgothian set is load-bearing itemization -> ITEM dissolves, mechanic lands on kit (item->lane law). No ailment attestable.
